exposure: age of mothers (less than or equal to 24 years)
first time antenatal care seekers after 3 months of gestation
mother or relatives' decision to seek discharge from hospital
lack of insistence from doctor or staff for the mandatory 48-hour stay
outcome: early discharge from hospital after delivery (less than 48 hours)
cohort: Mothers in the rural area of Beed block, Maharashtra, India, who were discharged from hospitals either less than 48 hours (cases) or more than 48 hours (controls) after delivery.
finding: Factors independently associated with early discharge included younger maternal age, late initiation of antenatal care, delivery in government hospitals, mother's/relatives' decision to seek discharge, and lack of insistence from healthcare staff for a mandatory 48-hour stay.
